q: Network-Attached Storage (NAS) is:
choices: An IP-based file-sharing device connected to a LAN
A block-level dedicated Fibre Channel network
A disk directly attached to one server
explain: **NAS is an IP-based file-sharing device connected to a LAN**.

q: NAS uses protocols such as ...............
explain: NAS بيستخدم **TCP/IP و NFS و CIFS و FTP**.

q: A NAS device is optimized for file-serving tasks such as storing, retrieving, and accessing files for applications and clients.
explain: **True**: الـ NAS متحسّن للـ file-serving.

q: NAS is dedicated solely to block services, running a real-time operating system tailored for block-serving.
explain: **False**: الـ NAS مخصص لـ **file services** مش block. الـ **block-level** دي SAN.

q: In NAS, the file transfer speed is not as fast as DAS.
explain: **True**: من عيوب الـ NAS إن **سرعة نقل الملفات أقل من الـ DAS**.

q: The NAS operating system translates file I/O requests into block I/O on the storage media, retrieves the data, and converts it back to file-level I/O.
explain: **True**: ده دور الـ NAS OS.

q: Unlike a general-purpose server, a NAS device:
choices: Is dedicated solely to file services with an optimized OS
explain: الـ NAS **single-purpose** ومخصص للـ file services بـ **real-time OS** متخصص.

q: Compared with traditional file servers, a NAS device can:
choices: Handle more users and offer server consolidation
explain: **can handle more users than traditional file servers — offering the benefits of server consolidation**.

q: Which NAS benefit offloads file-serving tasks from general-purpose servers?
explain: **Efficiency: offloads file-serving from general servers**.

q: Supporting both UNIX and Windows clients using open-standard protocols is the NAS benefit of:
explain: **Flexibility**.

q: Redundant networking, replication, and clustering for failover provide NAS:
explain: **High availability**.

q: Which NAS benefit minimizes duplication, simplifies management, and improves data protection?
explain: **Centralized storage**.

q: Which is a disadvantage of NAS listed in the lecture?
choices: Users need some basic knowledge of computer networking
It is more expensive than SAN
explain: العيوب: أبطأ من DAS، و**محتاج معرفة شبكات أساسية**، والمميزات بتعتمد على الـ chip والـ firmware.

q: NAS uses ______ access for all of its I/O operations.
explain: **NAS uses file-level access for all of its I/O operations**.

q: A file I/O request specifies:
choices: The file to be accessed, but not its logical block address
explain: **File I/O ... specifies the file but does not specify its logical block address**.

q: In NAS, ............ is a structured way of storing and organizing data files.
explain: **File system**.

q: Many file systems maintain a ______ to simplify finding and accessing files.
explain: **file access table**.

q: .............. creates a link between the file system and the operating system.
explain: **Mounting**، والـ file system لازم يتعمله mount قبل الوصول.

q: In the file system tree, files are found at:
explain: **Files at leaf nodes**، والفولدرات في **intermediate nodes**، والشجرة بتبدأ من **mount point (root)**.

q: Unmounting a file system:
explain: **Unmounting a file system ends the user–file system relationship**.

q: Who sets permissions on a shared file (read, write, execute, append, delete, list)?
explain: **The creator/owner of a file sets permissions**.

q: In NAS, ............. adds encryption for secure file transfer.
explain: **SFTP / FTPS (FTP over SSH)** بيضيف تشفير. أما الـ **FTP العادي** فمش مشفّر.

q: Standard FTP is:
explain: **Standard FTP is insecure (unencrypted)**.

q: A file system distributed across multiple hosts that provides unified access is a:
The ______ acts as the brain of the NAS, handling file requests, running the OS, and managing I/O.
explain: **NAS Head (CPU + Memory) = brain**.

q: In NAS, ............ provide connectivity between NAS and the IP network.
explain: **NICs**، وممكن أكتر من واحد للـ redundancy والـ throughput.

q: In NAS, the file-sharing protocol used for UNIX/Linux clients is .................
explain: **NFS → UNIX/Linux**.

q: In NAS, the file-sharing protocol used for Windows clients is .................
explain: **CIFS/SMB → Windows**.

q: Which are examples of industry-standard storage protocols used by NAS to connect physical disks?
explain: **ATA, SCSI, FC** لتوصيل الديسكات. أما NFS و CIFS فدي file-sharing protocols.

q: CIFS stands for:
explain: **CIFS = Common Internet File System** (ومعاه **SMB = Server Message Block**).

q: ............. is a self-contained system: NAS head, storage, and OS all in one chassis.
explain: **Integrated NAS**: all-in-one و plug-and-play.

q: In........., the NAS head is connected to a SAN backend.
explain: **Gateway NAS**: head منفصل + SAN.

q: Integrated NAS is mainly targeted at:
choices: Small to medium workgroups and departments
explain: **Integrated NAS: Small to medium workgroups**، و scalability محدودة بس سهل.

q: In a gateway NAS, the back-end connection to storage uses:
explain: **Back-End (NAS ↔ Storage): FC SAN or iSCSI fabric**.

q: Which NAS implementation provides higher scalability for medium to large enterprises?
explain: **Gateway NAS**: high-performance و scalable.

q: Integrated NAS may use ______ for higher throughput and redundancy.
explain: **May use Link Aggregation (LACP)**.

q: The first step of the NAS I/O process is:
choices: The client packages the I/O request into TCP/IP and sends it to the NAS
The NAS converts to block I/O
explain: **1. Request Sent**: الـ client يغلّف الطلب في TCP/IP.

q: In the NAS I/O process, after receiving the request the NAS:
choices: Converts it into block-level I/O and accesses the storage pool
Converts it to an FC frame for the client
explain: **2. Conversion to Block I/O**.

q: Which protocols handle file I/O requests to a remote file system managed by the NAS?
explain: **The NFS and CIFS protocols handle file I/O requests**.

q: One of the most significant sources of latency in a NAS environment is:
explain: **Network congestion is one of the most significant sources of latency**.

q: More router hops in a NAS environment cause:
explain: **Number of Hops – More router hops add IP processing delays**.

q: Delays caused by slow LDAP servers belong to which latency factor?
explain: **Authentication Services**: تأخير لو الـ LDAP بطيء.

q: Link errors, buffer overflows, or mismatched speed/duplex settings cause:
explain: **Retransmissions** بتزوّد التأخير.

q: Deep directory structures or poor file system layouts cause delays in:
explain: **File/Directory Lookup & Metadata**.

q: In NAS, ............... abstracts (hides) the physical location of files from users and applications.
explain: **File-level virtualization**.

q: With file-level virtualization, users access files through:
explain: **single, unified namespace** مهما كان مكان الملف.

q: A key benefit of file-level virtualization is:
choices: It removes the need for a network
Files can be moved between NAS devices without disrupting users
explain: **File mobility**: نقل وتجميع وتوسيع التخزين **من غير تغيير مسارات المستخدمين**.

q: The key distinction between SAN and NAS is that:
choices: NAS is block-level and SAN is file-level
SAN manages I/O on a block level, whereas NAS manages I/O on a file level
explain: **SAN = block level** · **NAS = file level**.

q: Compared with SAN, NAS is:
choices: Much cheaper and uses the standard Ethernet network
More expensive and uses Fibre Channel
explain: الـ NAS **أرخص بكتير** وبيستخدم **Ethernet عادي** بدل FC.

q: Which protocol is typically used by NAS (file level) rather than SAN?
explain: **NFS** = file-level ← NAS. أما **FC و iSCSI** فـ block-level ← SAN.
